title: aeluropus macrostachyus
intro: Aeluropus macrostachyus, commonly known as sand grass or beach grass, is a type of perennial plant native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant is rich in health benefits, including the potential to treat various health issues such as fever, inflammation, and skin infections, due to its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Aeluropus macrostachyus include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and prevent the growth of fungi. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
